title: 첫 출근, 커피 한 잔의 악연
summary: 재벌가 막내딸 한서연은 '윤서연'이라는 가명으로 태일그룹 전략기획팀 계약직 비서로 첫 출근한다. 엘리베이터에서 내리다 팀장 강도현의 흰 셔츠에 커피를 쏟고, 선임 비서 차유나가 그녀를 계약직이라고 소개하자 도현은 '여긴 실수 한 번이면 끝'이라고 차갑게 경고한다. 그런데 서연이 떨어뜨린 손수건을 팀장실에서 집어 든 도현은 거기 수놓인 한서그룹 가문 문양을 알아보고 표정이 굳는다.
cliffhanger: 팀장실에서 서연의 손수건에 수놓인 한서그룹 문양을 발견한 도현이 "계약직 비서가 이걸 왜...?"라며 문 너머 서연을 노려본다.

shots.action_ko: 엘리베이터 문이 열리자 커피를 들고 뛰어나오던 서연이 타려던 도현과 정면으로 부딪혀 그의 흰 셔츠에 커피를 쏟는다.
shots.prompt_en: Cinematic Korean drama, vertical 9:16, glossy premium K-drama look, soft film lighting with warm highlights and cool office shadows, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, subtle film grain, realistic skin texture, consistent character faces, no on-screen text, no logos. Setting: brushed steel elevator doors sliding open onto a modern high-rise corporate open office, white desks with monitors, glass partitions, large floor-to-ceiling windows showing a city skyline, cool daylight, potted green plants, minimal clean design, no visible signage. Character 1: Korean woman, 25 years old, slim petite build, 163cm, oval face with soft jawline, large bright double-lidded brown eyes, small straight nose, natural pink lips, fair clear skin, long straight dark brown hair just below the shoulders with soft see-through bangs, tied in a low ponytail, wearing an ivory silk blouse tucked into a high-waist black pencil skirt, simple black low heels, thin delicate silver wristwatch, small pearl stud earrings. Character 2: Korean man, 31 years old, tall lean athletic build, 185cm, sharp V-line jaw, defined cheekbones, narrow intense monolid-leaning eyes with straight thick eyebrows, high straight nose, thin firm lips, fair skin, short neat black hair with a clean side part swept back, no facial hair, wearing a tailored charcoal-gray three-piece suit, crisp white dress shirt, dark navy silk tie, black leather oxford shoes, minimal black-strap watch. Action: the elevator doors open, the woman rushes out holding a paper coffee cup without a logo and collides head-on with the man stepping in; brown coffee splashes across his white shirt and vest; she gasps in shock. Camera: medium shot, quick slight push-in on impact, slow-motion splash for one beat. Sound: elevator chime, soft thud, liquid splash, her gasp. She says in Korean: "어머! 죄송합니다!"

shots.action_ko: 도현이 얼룩진 셔츠를 천천히 내려다본 뒤, 고개를 들어 서연을 얼음처럼 차갑게 노려본다.
